title: Organizations & teams
description: Organization membership, verified invitations and team administration.
intro: Manage organization membership separately from access to research. Joining an organization does not grant workspace keys or permission to read lab books.
fileWorkflow: Invitations and acceptances are exchanged as signed files. Send the acceptance back to the administrator, then import their confirmation. This does not connect installations for live synchronization.
name: Organization name
teamHelp: Only active members of this organization can belong to its teams. Team membership does not itself grant content access.
roleHelp: Administrators manage membership and teams. This role does not authorize reading research, publication or recovery.
verified: I verified this complete fingerprint with the person through another channel.
empty: No organizations administered by this identity in this workspace.
invitationCreated: Invitation downloaded. Send it to the verified recipient.
acceptanceCreated: Acceptance downloaded. Send it to the inviting administrator for enrollment.
confirmationCreated: Member enrolled. Send the downloaded confirmation to the recipient.
receiptHelp: These are retained receipts, not a live membership check. Later changes at another installation are not synchronized here.
chooseIdentity: Choose a public identity file and verify its fingerprint.
invalidFile: Choose an original Observanda organization file smaller than 64 KiB.
verifyFirst: Review the file and verify the sender's complete fingerprint before continuing.
changed: The workspace changed. Reopen Organizations & teams before continuing.
noSecret: Only your public signing identity is included. Your private key remains on this installation.
activityHelp: Saved membership and team changes, newest first. Only current administrators can view this history.
